title: From Generalist to Specialist: A Context-Fusion Framework for Endoscopic Polyp Reporting with a Frozen VLM
abstract: arXiv:2608.15580v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable endoscopic polyp reporting requires integrating quantitative lesion sizing, standardized Paris classification, and clinically meaningful morphological description within a single record. General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) offer a unified interface for image understanding and report generation. Existing specialization strategies, however, typically rely on task-specific models or model-weight adaptation, leaving unresolved how to introduce reliable specialist knowledge while preserving both this unified interface and the VLM's pretrained capabilities. We introduce a context-fusion framework that specializes a frozen general-purpose VLM through both implicit instruction context and explicit transduction context without modifying its pretrained weights. translated_title: 从通用到专精：一种用于内镜息肉报告生成的冻结视觉语言模型上下文融合框架
translated_abstract: 可靠的内镜息肉报告要求在同一份记录中整合定量病灶尺寸测量、标准化的巴黎分型和具有临床意义的形态学描述。通用型视觉语言模型（VLMs）为图像理解和报告生成提供了统一接口。然而，现有的专精化策略通常依赖于任务特定模型或模型权重调整，这未能解决如何在保持统一接口和VLM预训练能力的同时引入可靠的专精知识的问题。我们提出了一种上下文融合框架，通过隐式指令上下文和显式转导上下文对冻结的通用VLM进行专精化，而无需修改其预训练权重。具体而言，一个自监督的息肉编码器检索相关的图像-报告对作为显式的查询特定证据，而学习到的连续专精令牌则提供隐式指导。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需修改权重即可冻结通用视觉语言模型，通过隐式指令和显式转导上下文融合实现内镜息肉报告专精化的新框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel context-fusion framework that specializes a frozen general-purpose VLM for endoscopic polyp reporting by integrating implicit instruction and explicit transduction contexts without modifying pretrained weights.
